event.text: I recommend a Counsel clinician review your losartan refill request in this thread, with a same-day service-hours target. Your reported home reading of 122/78 and two years of stable use suggest no urgent problem. If you run out before a refill is issued, reply here and also contact your pharmacy or usual prescriber. If you develop new chest pain, fainting, a sudden severe headache, or new weakness or speech trouble, call 911 for immediate emergency assessment.
